audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is right: the page never names Mirror Image, Sigil of Malice, Ethereal Chains or Mimic. Distortion is the only ability mentioned, and the two interactions that actually decide the lane were absent.
audit.why: Sigil of Malice marks for 3.5s and any follow-up ability detonates it — that detonation is the burst, so the mark on you is the warning. Ethereal Chains only roots if you stay shackled for 1.5 seconds, so breaking range denies the root entirely. Mirror Image triggers below 40% health: she goes invisible for 1 second and leaves a copy that deals no damage, which is what eats a greedy finishing bloom.
audit.corrected: All four abilities named and both interactions written into cooldowns, dontsFull and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side disagreed with win[N]: sides read LeBlanc, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, Skill, Skill, Skill, while win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Neeko x4, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, Neeko. diff also reads TRICKY at 7/10 against a 63.7% win rate over 146 games.
audit.why: Seven rows rendering two different winners, and a difficulty label that contradicts both the chart and the win rate.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match win[N] exactly, every why rewritten in the same proposal so rows 4-5 argue for LeBlanc and the rest for Neeko, and diff moved to FAVOURED at 4.5/10 with the two prose ratings updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic 'level 6 adds the ambush; Luden's makes the package lethal', which claims the exact window the chart gives to LeBlanc.
audit.why: Mimic is 45/35/25s and gives her a second cast of a basic spell — that is her level 6 spike and it out-bursts Neeko's one 90-120s rotation. Neeko's spike is levels 3-5, rooting a Distortion inside its 4-second return, and again at two items where AoE beats single-target burst.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around Mimic's cooldown and the Distortion return window.

notes: The packet defect (no LeBlanc ability ever named) is fixed: Mirror Image, Sigil of Malice, Ethereal Chains and Mimic all reach the page now. All seven chart rows disagreed between layers — sides moved to match win[N] and the packet levelChart exactly, with every why rewritten in the same proposal. diff moved TRICKY -> FAVOURED and 7/10 -> 4.5/10 to match a 63.7% win rate over 146 games and a chart that gives Neeko five of seven rows; breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t were updated in the same proposal so the prose does not contradict the enum. tone '#ff8b3d' still reads as the tricky-matchup orange and should be reconciled with the new diff by whoever owns that palette. carryRating left at 7.5/10 — she remains a real carry threat even in a lane Neeko is favoured in. LeBlanc's E carries a revealsStealth flag; Neeko's disguise is not stealth in Riot's text, so I made no claim about Ethereal Chains revealing a disguised Neeko. Mechanical lint pass (tools/matchup-lint.js). MISGENDER: the enemy is female and the full layer addressed her as male; every flagged field corrected in place. COPY_PASTE_BLEED: Do/Don't bodies that were the generic tradeGood/tradeBad string pasted under an unrelated title were replaced with bodies that argue their own title, using kit numbers. COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE: rebuilt around real cooldowns and ranges from champ-data/_kits.
